title: 第15章 根骨提升第16章 决裂
slug: 苟在武道世界加点长生
content_zh:
第15章根骨提升想到这儿，他竟有些松了口气，最近这内宅中真是发生了太多的事情，他打心眼里不希望这次事故又是有人故意为之。
“楚皇客气了，我族靠楚皇庇佑才从战火中得以幸存，今后灵族愿以楚皇马首是瞻。”灵茉朝着楚骁郑重的躬身一礼。
关云鹏虽然学习成绩拔尖，可是每当到了关系命运的高考考场上时，他总是会发生这样那样的问题，考了两次，都没能考出真实成绩，可是中专他说什么都不想上。
旁边的关云山听道石建国的话后，一张脸已经沉了下来，当真是面沉似水，看着石建国的，双眼露出怒色。
“拿上它，带着外面那天地之灵赶紧走吧。”玄武的神念朝楚骁挥了挥手，身形已经变得虚幻了起来。
「说！这个幻境要怎么样才能通过！陈雯雯和司马栩栩现在到底在尼伯龙根的哪一块地方！」路明非解开了叶胜的裤腰带，一把抓住他的裤子让冷风灌了进去，冷得后者一哆嗦。
这些日子来，她为什么一下都没有出现过？她是不是也已知道叶开的死讯？
可以说，公会的产生也许是游戏发展的必然，但是公会的成型，发展，都是在林迪的控制和引导下完成的蜕变，没有人比他更合适讲公会了。
墨麒麟身形一幻，便出现在了楚骁面前，这速度吓得楚骁身后众人全都拿出了兵器准备出手。可墨麒麟并没有攻击楚骁，只是抽动着鼻子在他身上嗅着，楚骁也没有动，就这样任凭对方像一条狗一样在他身上一通乱闻。
连后勤辎重队伍的辆车都抛弃了，全军每人自己携带十天的粮食，其他的全部用驽马背负着。
“程咬金，你的骑兵只配野战，这攻城之事，还得我们步兵来！所以，你想第一个冲进城去，只怕是在做梦了！”秦琼见好不容易能奚落一下他，自然不会放过如此机会。
武海有些结巴的应了一声，在他对李大牛认知的世界里，完全不知道原来李大牛其实也有惆怅的时候。
把原本一场庄严郑重的结盟大会，变得有些滑稽，如同闹剧，这如何令人不怒？
并没有想象中的门可罗雀，只是昔日这里门口的两个石狮不再威风凛凛。那钉子大门之上满目疮痍，此刻门口站着那许多执着火把的汉子正在嚷嚷着。
孔啸天愣了一下，没想到是为了这件事，扫了妹妹一眼，翎雨也看着啸天。
李凝此刻在洞中捏着一封信，这封信并不是什么战报，也不是阿托部送来的。
清舞轻啜一口，幽香顿时在齿间游走，香气沁人心扉，让人神清气爽。
李凝好不容易找来张莹莹把人封住，如何肯放他离开？光隐剑被张莹莹接住，这剑儿剑柄如玉，剑身薄如蝉翼，通体就是一阵寒芒。
然而，令姜易惊讶的并不是木皇诀的神奇，而是那方白露居然在这个时刻会搭救自己一把。
“你怎么说话呢，什么叫这次秉公处理，我什么时候没有秉公处理了？”孙美玲听了李丹最后一句话，心里的火忽的一下就着起来了，压都压不住。

尽管我知道沈柏腾让我坐上这个位置的目的并不单纯，可以后的事情，以后再说，兵来将挡水来土掩。不踏进这一步，永远都不知道这圈子内的一切买了什么药葫芦。
皓月自然不能放开无欢，不然无欢在神智混乱之时做了什么，那就是无法挽回了。
黄山一听，顿时感到万分的不好意思。刚才自已那一番作为好像有点急色的样子了。好在赵若现在五观和五感都不在，要不还不得羞死。
如今，周真儿两眼几乎肿成核桃，两边的脸颊都印着一个巴掌印，一边像是吹了气的气球一般高高鼓起，一边只是有些红肿，看起来十分滑稽。
他说的是之前跟陈金辉一起私开城门收钱放人的举动，虽说当时薛广只是不想得罪人，这才随大众的参与，但仍旧担心陈武会对他有坏印象。
从此以后就只能是以单独的金丹炼尸身份存在于世间了，再也不能使用合体的变身功法了。
他经常在想，若是当初他不那么贪心，他选择默默地守候她，是不是他就可以和她一直以蓝颜知己的身份见到她？
没分钟的时间，汪婷就把酒店背景的照片发到了朋友圈里。肖郡然看着，简直头大呀，这是一间酒店的照片呀，可是要他仅仅凭借一张找我去挨家酒店的找，那得找到哪辈子去？要知道旅游景点最多的就是旅店了。
就在这一刻，一声洪亮的声音穿过了大批骑兵的喊杀，悠悠传遍了战场。
“姐你就宽心吧，菲菲这么懂事，有什么好操心的。”说着推了推刘雨菲，让刘雨菲赶紧上楼去。
然后周清了清喉咙，清亮的声音响彻墓室。我不懂京剧，所以他唱的是什么剧目什么角儿我都不知道，但看龙高简三人的神情。显然是听得颇为动容。蓝问柳则是转过了头，没有看。
若江尘不识好歹，一心要利用周明珠的话，她并不介意对江尘采取一点手段，只不过，那般撕破脸面，注定不会太好看就是了。

"Emperor Chu, you're welcome. Our clan only survived the war with Emperor Chu's blessing. From now on, the Ling Clan is willing to take Emperor Chu's lead as its leader." Ling Mo bowed solemnly towards Chu Xiao.
Although Guan Yunpeng's academic performance is top-notch, he always has problems of one kind or another when he takes the college entrance examination, which is a matter of fate. He took the exam twice and failed to get a real score. However, he said he didn't want to go to the technical secondary school.
After hearing Shi Jianguo's words, Guan Yunshan's face darkened. He looked at Shi Jianguo with an angry look in his eyes.
"Take it and leave quickly with the spirits of heaven and earth outside." Xuanwu waved his hand to Chu Xiao with his spiritual mind, and his figure had become illusory.
"Tell me! How can we pass this illusion! Where in the Nibelungen are Chen Wenwen and Sima Xuxu now!" Lu Mingfei unbuttoned Ye Sheng's belt, grabbed his pants and let the cold wind pour in, making the latter shiver.
Why hasn't she appeared these days? Did she also know about Ye Kai's death?
It can be said that the emergence of guilds may be inevitable for the development of the game, but the formation and development of guilds are all transformations completed under the control and guidance of Lindy. No one is more suitable to talk about guilds than him.
Mo Qilin's figure suddenly appeared in front of Chu Xiao. This speed frightened everyone behind Chu Xiao into taking out their weapons and preparing to take action. But Mo Qilin didn't attack Chu Xiao, he just twitched his nose and sniffed him. Chu Xiao didn't move, just letting the other party sniff around him like a dog.
Even the vehicles of the logistics team were abandoned. Each person in the army carried ten days of food by himself, and the rest was carried on the backs of horses.
"Cheng Yaojin, your cavalry is only suitable for field battles. We need our infantry to attack the city! So, if you want to be the first to rush into the city, you are just dreaming!" Qin Qiong saw that it was not easy to ridicule him, so naturally she would not let go of such an opportunity.
Wu Hai stuttered in response. In the world he knew about Li Daniu, he had no idea that Li Daniu actually had moments of melancholy.
What was originally a solemn alliance meeting turned into a bit funny, like a farce. How can this not make people angry?
It's not as deserted as imagined, but the two stone lions at the door are no longer majestic. The nail gate was covered with devastation, and there were many men holding torches standing at the door, shouting.
Kong Xiaotian was stunned for a moment. Unexpectedly, it was because of this matter that he glanced at his sister. Ling Yu also looked at Xiaotian.
Li Ning was holding a letter in the cave at the moment. This letter was not a battle report, nor was it sent by Atuobu.
Qingwu took a sip, and the fragrance immediately spread between her teeth. The aroma was refreshing and refreshing.
Li Ning finally found Zhang Yingying and locked him up. How could he let him go? The Guangyin Sword was caught by Zhang Yingying. The sword's handle was like jade, its body was as thin as a cicada's wing, and there was a cold glow all over the body.
However, what surprised Jiang Yi was not the magic of the Wood Emperor Jue, but that Fang Bailu actually rescued him at this moment.
"How are you talking? What does it mean to handle things justly this time? When did I not handle things justly?" After hearing Li Dan's last words, Sun Meiling suddenly felt the fire in her heart and couldn't suppress it.
Although I know that Shen Boteng's purpose in letting me sit in this position is not simple. We can deal with the matter later, and the soldiers will cover up the water and the earth. If you don't take this step, you will never know what medicine everyone in this circle has bought.
Haoyue naturally couldn't let go of Wu Huan, otherwise what Wu Huan did when he was in a state of confusion would be irreversible.
yellowWhen Shan heard this, he immediately felt extremely embarrassed. What I did just now seemed a bit impatient. Fortunately, Zhao Ruo's five senses and perceptions are gone now, otherwise he would die of embarrassment.
Now, Zhou Zhen'er's eyes were almost swollen into walnuts, and there were slap marks on both cheeks. One side was bulging up like an inflated balloon, while the other side was just a little red and swollen, looking very funny.
He was talking about his previous action of privately opening the city gates with Chen Jinhui to collect money and release people. Although Xue Guang only wanted to let the public participate because he did not want to offend anyone, he was still worried that Chen Wu would have a bad impression of him.
From now on, he can only exist in the world as a single golden elixir refining corpse, and can no longer use the combined transformation technique.
He often wonders, if he was not so greedy and chose to wait for her silently, would he be able to see her as her confidant?
Within minutes, Wang Ting sent the photo of the hotel background to her circle of friends. Xiao Junran looked at it, and it was really confusing. This was a photo of a hotel, but if he had to search for me from hotel to hotel with just one photo, how long would it take him to find it? You must know that the most tourist attractions are hotels.
At this moment, a loud voice broke through the shouts of a large number of cavalry and spread throughout the battlefield.
"Sister, please relax, Feifei is so sensible, what is there to worry about." She said and pushed Liu Yufei, asking Liu Yufei to go upstairs quickly.
Then Zhou cleared his throat, and his clear voice echoed through the tomb. I don't understand Peking Opera, so I don't know what kind of play he is singing or what role he is singing, but I can see the expressions on the faces of the three of them, Long Gao Jian. Apparently he was very moved by what he heard. Lan Wenliu turned his head and didn't look.
If Jiang Chen didn't know what was right and wanted to take advantage of Zhou Mingzhu, she wouldn't mind taking some measures against Jiang Chen, but it would definitely not look good if he broke his face like that.
